<!-- Generated by tools/vxrt_agents.py from .agents/commands/vxrt-tune.md — edit that, then run tools/vxrt_agents.py sync. -->
Tune the Windows VR game `$ARGUMENTS` on VXRuntime for this Mac, with settings only.

1. If no game was named, list the installed games (vxrt MCP `list_games`, or `python3 tools/vxrt_run.py --list`) and ask which one; stop until the user answers.
2. Get the brief: `python3 tools/vxrt_doctor.py "$ARGUMENTS" --goal tune --lang en --agent claude`. It gives the goal, when the task is done, the facts, the tools to use first, the rules and when to stop. Follow it.
3. Talk to the user in their language.
